column5:
- name: Put the checkout on the test environment's import path
# Route-script children import hermes_cli by module path, and run_tests.sh's env -i drops PYTHONPATH. Minted -I
# launchers and child trees that are their own whole sys.path must still resolve only their own files, so the
# finder serves the project's top-level names, after every other finder, and never under -I.
run: |
"$HERMES_PYTHON" - "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys, sysconfig, tomllib
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
found = tomllib.loads((root / "pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["tool"]["setuptools"]["packages"]["find"]
names = sorted({p.split(".")[0] for p in found["include"]} | {f.stem for f in root.glob("*.py") if f.name != "setup.py"})
finder = ("import sys, importlib.machinery; sys.flags.isolated or 'HermesCheckoutFinder' in "
"[getattr(f, '__name__', '') for f in sys.meta_path] or sys.meta_path.append(type("
"'HermesCheckoutFinder', (), {'find_spec': staticmethod(lambda name, path=None, target=None, "
"_f=importlib.machinery.PathFinder, _n=frozenset(%r): _f.find_spec(name, [%r]) "
"if path is None and name in _n else None)}))\n")
pathlib.Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"], "hermes-checkout.pth").write_text(finder % (names, str(root)), encoding="utf-8")
PY

column3: # starves cold child startup before the fixture's idle deadline.

column4: HERMES_E2E_ARTIFACTS: ${{ runner.temp }}\\win-update-e2e\n# One journey per file, all in parallel (each is mostly network + subprocess wait).\nHERMES_TEST_WORKERS: '6'
column5: HERMES_E2E_ARTIFACTS: ${{ runner.temp }}\\win-update-e2e\n# Bound concurrent fake profiles to limit peak C: disk pressure.\nHERMES_TEST_WORKERS: '2'

column4: name: Windows install.ps1 + hermes update E2E
column5: name: Windows install.ps1 + hermes update E2E (${{ matrix.slice }}/2)

# Each slice gets its own runner disk: journeys never remove their fake profiles, and ten fill a standard runner's C:.
strategy:
fail-fast: false
matrix:
slice: [1, 2]
if: matrix.slice == 1  # run_tests.sh's sorted round-robin puts test_crash_cells.py in slice 1

column3: # Get the merge base between this PR and main
column5: MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref || 'main' }} HEAD)

column3: MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref || 'main' }} HEAD)
column5:
# Exclude unrelated release history from a direct dispatch's attribution.
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = workflow_dispatch ] && [ -z "${{ inputs.commit }}" ]; then
for b in $(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/remotes/origin/release/*'); do
mb=$(git merge-base "$b" HEAD) || continue
[ "$mb" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && continue
if [ "$(git rev-list --count "$mb..HEAD")" -lt "$(git rev-list --count "$MERGE_BASE..HEAD")" ]; then MERGE_BASE=$mb; fi
done
fi
